glossEn: of or relating to an economy, the system of production and management of material wealth / of or relating to the science of economics
note: of or relating to an economy / of or relating to the science of economics。**本词最常用的义**。线索：economic growth / economic policy。两条边界英文有别（经济体系 vs 经济学），中文看不出差别，合并。注意与 economical（节省的）拼写差一个字母。

glossEn: using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
note: using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effective results。线索：an economical car / economical use of time。**注意拼写**：economic（经济的）vs economical（节省的），这是常见错拼点。

glossEn: concerned with worldly necessities of life (especially money)
note: concerned with worldly necessities of life (especially money)。现代英语里较少单独使用，raw=2 那条（节省的）在实际语料中远比本条常见。
